prompt: Which change would let customers know they have ordered the coffee they meant to buy without losing what worked along the queue?
promptZh: 哪項改動能讓顧客知道自己點到了想買的咖啡，同時保留排隊時已經有效的做法？

options.text: Keep both coffees on the menu board and send the drink button to the till. After it is pressed, return the customer screen to payment.
options.zh: 菜單保留兩款咖啡，按鈕把飲品選擇送到收銀臺。按下後，顧客螢幕回到付款畫面。
options.whyZh: 保留排隊時能看到的兩款，也確實送出選擇；但一跳回付款，顧客仍看不到收銀臺是否收到想要的飲品。

options.text: Keep both coffees on the menu board. Use the drink buttons to send the order and show the choice the till received before asking for payment.
options.zh: 菜單保留兩款咖啡。用按鈕送出飲品，並在請顧客付款前顯示收銀臺收到的選擇。
options.whyZh: 排隊時仍能看懂有哪些選擇；點餐時會送到收銀臺，顧客也看得到實際收到哪一款，不必再點一次或猜是否有成功。

options.text: Keep both coffees on the menu board and send the drink button to the till. Show whatever the customer last pressed as soon as they touch it.
options.zh: 菜單保留兩款咖啡，按鈕把飲品選擇送到收銀臺。顧客按下時，立即顯示最後按的是什麼。
options.whyZh: 顯示按動內容可讓顧客知道手指選了什麼，但不代表收銀臺已收到。要確認訂單不能只回顯按鈕。

options.text: Take the two coffee lines off the menu board. On the payment screen, show the choice received at the till before taking payment.
options.zh: 從菜單移除兩款咖啡的列表，在付款畫面上先顯示收銀臺收到的選擇。
options.whyZh: 這能確認訂單，但拿掉排隊時能看到的兩款資訊，使顧客得等到收銀臺才能知道可選什麼。

explanationZh: 排隊時仍能看懂有哪些選擇；點餐時會送到收銀臺，顧客也看得到實際收到哪一款，不必再點一次或猜是否有成功。
evidence: the two coffees had lines of their own. / I thought I’d already ordered. / It sent the choice to the till; the screen immediately returned to the payment amount. / She asked if she had to tell the cashier her choice again. / Lunch customers often decide what to have before they reach the register / show the choice the till received before taking payment / even if the till hasn’t received anything.

vocabulary.note: 此處是接收訂單的收銀系統；顧客螢幕顯示按過的選項，不一定代表收銀端已收到。
